import ctypes
import os

def load_gsl_libraries():
    """Load GSL libraries in the correct order."""
    ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgslcblas.so", mode=ctypes.RTLD_GLOBAL)
    return ctypes.CDLL("/usr/local/gsl/lib/libgsl.so")

def compute_bessel_J0(x):
    """Compute the Bessel function J0(x) using GSL."""
    gsl = load_gsl_libraries()

    # Define the return type and argument types for gsl_sf_bessel_J0
    gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0.restype = ctypes.c_double
    gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0.argtypes = [ctypes.c_double]

    # Call the function and return the result
    return gsl.gsl_sf_bessel_J0(ctypes.c_double(x))

    """Run assertion tests to validate correctness and error handling."""

    assert abs(compute_bessel_J0(0.0) - 1.0) < 1e-10, "Test case 1 failed: J0(0.0) should be 1.0"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_J0(1.0) - 0.7651976865579665) < 1e-10, "Test case 2 failed: J0(1.0) should be approximately 0.7651976865579665"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_J0(2.0) - 0.22389077914123562) < 1e-10, "Test case 3 failed: J0(2.0) should be approximately 0.22389077914123562"
    assert abs(compute_bessel_J0(5.0) - -0.1775967713143383) < 1e-10, "Test case 4 failed: J0(5.0) should be approximately -0.1775967713143383"

    # Edge case: Large input
    assert abs(compute_bessel_J0(100.0) - 0.01998585030422389) < 1e-10, "Test case 5 failed: J0(100.0) should be approximately 0.01998585030422389"

    print("All tests passed!")

if __name__ == "__main__":
    assert_test()
